authorization: Brian included TESSERA, StefaLand and Basin2Vec and requested a chapter, data and disk audit.

study.task: Daily retrospective discharge reconstruction; test incremental catchment-representation value and high-water/external-transfer limitations.
study.descriptor_history: Use 2018 as the common annual descriptor reference for the new controlled extension because full-census TESSERA coverage is near-complete; 2018 predates every held evaluation year. Keep the completed original H+A/AlphaEarth results and their 2017 descriptor basis unchanged. For the extension, align AlphaEarth and year-specific conventional controls to 2018 before fitting.
study.split_policy: Reuse the frozen chronological and whole-river assignments. External observed Q remains excluded from correction fitting, tuning and representations; target-river observed Q remains excluded from every spatial predictor/calibration path.
study.interpretation: Four representation products with different upstream inputs/pretraining. This is not a pure architecture comparison or an operational forecast experiment. Existing test outcomes are already inspected; label the extension exploratory.

comparison.C0: Existing H+A conventional correction; preserve its completed results unchanged.
comparison.C1: H+A plus compact raw summaries and geometry metadata from the additional StefaLand/Basin2Vec input families. Final raw feature list follows the verified checkpoint schema, not test scores.
comparison.why_refit_alphaearth: C1 differs from the original H+A; AlphaEarth must be fitted against C1 for a fair new comparison. This does not invalidate or overwrite the original 13.86% result.
comparison.raw_controls: Share new physical/climate/landscape/patch-metadata inputs through declared raw summaries. Match populations, histories and coverage. Retain that summaries and learned spatial/temporal encodings differ; do not claim identical upstream information processing.
comparison.estimator: Same pooled XGBoost log1p-residual learner and native RMSE selection, with existing article-faithful policy sensitivity.
comparison.dimension_handling: Retain each model's documented native descriptor initially; do not force 128/256-dimensional vectors to 64 or average different models' vectors. Any trainable preprocessing uses permitted training data only.
comparison.evaluation: Existing high-water daily MAE primary, all-day outcomes secondary, original p99/source-QA/spatial strata, full eligible census, paired date/year multiplicities across every model, all undefined draws and coverage retained. Report all representations rather than select a winner from favourable test slices.
comparison.coverage: Do not silently shrink the study to the intersection of available encoders. Preserve intended/available rows and paired-support estimates; define any C1 fallback explicitly before production scoring.
comparison.inference_scope: Frozen descriptor utility under one shared correction head. Not a replication of every native LSTM/residual pipeline or an upper bound on each model.

tessera.readiness: Full 394-catchment 2018 scale coverage is complete at >=97.4% for every polygon. Full native descriptor extraction is running.
tessera.raster_policy: Stream dequantized pixels and scales in bounded native-grid windows, area-weight them within the reference polygons, and persist compact means/counts/coverage/provenance. Reuse shared spatial chunks; avoid complete local mosaics or per-catchment raster duplication.
tessera.missingness: Selected Icechunk adapter marks NaN scales as source_nodata, not verified water. Respect store completion and source-specific validity; preserve unknown coverage, do not fill zero or infer water from NaN. Any water fraction requires separately justified mask evidence.
tessera.runtime: New isolated Python >=3.12 data environment. Preserve the completed Python 3.11/XGBoost environment.
tessera.aggregation: Dequantize each pixel first; stream fractional-area weighted sums, weights and second moments on the reference polygons. Keep raw 128-coordinate mean primary. Preserve coverage and support; no PCA/RGB or arbitrary prefix truncation.
tessera.normalization: Native raw dequantized v1.1 features; no imposed L2 normalization or fit-to-held-population whitening.

stefaland.role: Land-surface representation from physical attributes and meteorological histories
stefaland.readiness: A 46,914,220-byte candidate checkpoint is acquired and statically inspected; exact intended encoder, source normalizers, input history and runoff-free inference remain unresolved.
stefaland.candidate_caution: Candidate state dictionary contains P/Tmax/Tmin/PET/Runoff input projections. It is not established as the runoff-free checkpoint used by Liu et al. Do not supply held target observed Q, accept partial/randomly initialized encoder loading, or silently fill a native missing channel with zero.
stefaland.preparation: Verify a runoff-free encoder or a documented native missing-Runoff route, full parameter coverage, variable/source/unit lists, normalizers and annual descriptor pooling. Seek the authors' used descriptor recipe where needed; candidate existence alone does not establish usable features.
stefaland.feature_tap: Verify artifact-specific pre-reconstruction-decoder features. Inspected author helper uses dynamic hidden state plus contextual static hidden state, then period mean; not reconstructed variables or predicted runoff.
stefaland.normalization: Obtain verified native statistics or prescribed adaptation rule. Generic helper can calculate statistics from supplied arrays; no silent fitting to held/test data.
stefaland.sequence: Freeze artifact-compatible 2017 input/context and annual pooling. Paper uses 365-day pretraining; generic generator defaults to 3650-day windows. Do not assume equivalent or let later-year context enter the descriptor.
stefaland.missingness: Inspected encode_with_pretrained sets all-false masks and is_mask=False. NaN Runoff is not a verified omission route. Verify native masked inference or use Q-free artifact; never supply target observed Q.

basin2vec.readiness: Public code/normalization examples inspected. No encoder weight file found in the captured git tree; release API returned an empty release list and the advertised v1.0.0 embedding archive returned 404.
basin2vec.geography: Documented pretrained embedding collection is CONUS-only and cannot be looked up for European catchments.
basin2vec.preparation: Obtain a trained encoder with its precise channel metadata, normalizers and source definitions. Assemble basin-aligned monthly/static patches and geometry metadata for the existing 394 European reference polygons.
basin2vec.source_mismatch: Paper lists a six-variable monthly Daymet route; repository inventory/norm examples also contain tmean/wind. Actual trained monthly_variables and nonmonthly_variables must come from the checkpoint. Native NLCD and AgTile-US have no silent European substitutes.
basin2vec.adaptation: Document global/European source replacements and categorical crosswalks, real source resolution, trained missingness and pretraining-domain shift. Resampling to 64x64 does not create new physical resolution.
basin2vec.feature_tap: Final projected L2-normalized z from unaugmented inputs under eval/no-grad. Do not substitute h, branch vectors, area prediction or pre-projection states.
basin2vec.aggregation: For one-year 2017 comparison, normalized 2017 z. If longer pre-evaluation support is justified, average annual z then L2 normalize (paper Eq.14); do not use all-years US lookup vectors.
basin2vec.metadata: Checkpoint-specific scale/shape/effective-resolution schema and frozen log/standardization parameters. Paper lists 18 fields, 3 constant zero; repository defaults differ. No naive zeroing of unknown metadata/physical channels.

alphaearth.role: Satellite landscape anchor; preserve the completed 2017 result and align a new 2018 feature to the extension
alphaearth.feature_convention: Use all 64 raw catchment-mean coordinates. Pixel unit norm does not imply unit-norm basin mean; no added L2 normalization for the tree head.
alphaearth.readiness: Original 2017 extraction and results remain preserved. The extension requires 2018 annual catchment means to match TESSERA and the common extension reference year; those are not yet extracted.
alphaearth.version_note: Catalog identifies distributed product with AlphaEarth v2.1; original paper evaluated v2.0. Preserve actual saved source-image/hash receipts.

storage.source_byte_estimates: Area-based payload arithmetic, not compressed transfer sizes. Actual store has scales, masks, sharding and range requests; measure actual I/O before an acquisition ETA.
storage.example_window: 512x512x128 float32 is 128 MiB, before masks/temporary arrays.
storage.allowance_note: Planning allocation for isolated environments, bounded fetch cache, physical patch inputs, compact vectors and fitted heads. It is not a cap on scientifically required data; stream/offload if measurements exceed it.
storage.remote_recovery: Use existing chapter recovery storage if a retained cache actually needs offload; verify restoration before removing unique local material. No Azure VM or new cloud provisioning is needed for this audit.
storage.other_chapters: Do not modify, delete or offload any other chapter's data.

execution.current_authorization: Full TESSERA 2018 descriptor extraction across all 394 reference catchments is authorized after the completed census coverage assessment. This does not authorize fitting until other representation and C1 alignment requirements are resolved.
next_work: Complete full-census TESSERA 2018 descriptor extraction with per-zone resumable checkpoints and preserve the coverage/missingness manifest.
Extract 2018 AlphaEarth catchment descriptors and assemble year-aligned conventional C1 inputs before any extension scoring.
Resolve the exact StefaLand encoder/normalizer and Basin2Vec encoder/input-schema assets.
Retrieve only model-required 2018 physical inputs for compact raw C1 summaries; freeze the feature list before looking at extension outcomes.
Verify native input transforms, parameter coverage, label exclusion, date/polygon alignment and one CPU/available-MPS extraction path for each usable model.
Benchmark one matched outer fold and resource usage before scheduling the complete controlled model family.
